defects: Adds the extra conjuncts `a0 ∈ f.coeff.support ∧ b0 ∈ g.coeff.support` to the hypothesis; the gold's `UniqueMul f.coeff.support g.coeff.support a0 b0` is purely the uniqueness clause (∀ a∈supp f, b∈supp g, a*b=a0*b0 → a=a0∧b=b0) and does NOT require a0,b0 to themselves lie in the supports — it also covers the vacuous case where a0∉supp f or b0∉supp g (where both sides of the conclusion are 0). The produced statement therefore only proves a strict special case, not the same/equivalent general proposition.
